1263-4871-5670-6273.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-6273.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
1263-4871-5670-6273.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3480-3490-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3480-3490-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1170-4985-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4985-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2738-4871-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {R}.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3490-4050-7399-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-7399-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1172-1624-4668.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2034-2999-3490-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2999-3490-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

891-3967-5617.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1409-1418-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve both Exhibition Magician triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

851-967-3809-6798-7087.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1978-2392-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
1978-2392-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat

2957-3767-3918-6893.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using The Eternity Elevator's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2086-2292-6824.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

511-817-3062-4050-6753.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

372-3556-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker.
372-3556-4125.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

628-2292-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2292-5490.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

508-1656-3907-4283.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
It is your upkeep.
508-1656-3907-4283.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Underworld Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Underworld Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Underworld Hermit, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

215-2499-2972-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-2499-2972-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and use Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1495-2445-2744-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1495-2445-2744-3828.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
During the next player's turn, you may remove all of the +1/+1 counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1144-3510-4922.description:
Yavimaya causes all lands to be Forests in addition to their other types, thus Life and Limb causes all lands to be 1/1 Saproling creatures.
Because Plague Engineer gives all Saprolings your opponents control -1/-1, they die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Whenever an opponent plays a land, it will also die as a state-based action.

2816-4734.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Cradle Clearcutter.
2816-4734.notablePrerequisites: Cradle Clearcutter does not have summoning sickness.
2816-4734.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

186-1247-4390.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1235-1718-4285-4863.description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Catalyst Elemental.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Catalyst Elemental.
Revolutionist enters the battlefield triggers, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to hand.
Holding priority, activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
